name: Jumping Jean
summary:
Play as the blue-collared everyman in this retro-inspired sidescroller!

In Jumping Jean, you play as an everyday hero, a simple worker determined to save the day.

You're no superpowered plumber, and you're certainly not the heroic electrician of the kingdom, Jumping Jean!

You are a humble minion tasked with defending your homeland! You'll move left, right, and... actually, that's about it!

Can you survive an oncoming onslaught of dangerous electricians using nothing but your ability to move sideways?
